title: Davao ‘Saba’ bananas enter Australian market

blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — The Department of Agriculture in the Davao Region (DA-11) reported on Wednesday about the first export shipment of Frozen Whole Steamed Saba (Cardava banana) to Australia on Sept. 22. The exportation was facilitated through the DA-11’s Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Division (AMAD). In a statement, DA-11 regional technical director for operations Marie Ann Constantino said the initial shipment of 7,000 kilograms of steamed Cardava bananas, processed by Golden Flavours, is scheduled to sail on Oct. 3. Tentatively, the cargo will arrive in Australia on Nov. 3. The bananas, harvested at 90 to 100 percent maturity, are blast-frozen at –18°C, […]...
